mapper.select: select a.VISIT_TIME as visitTime, a.CUSTOMER_ID as customerId, a.CUSTOM_NAME as customName, a.user_id as userId, a.EXECUTE_USER_CODE as createUser, a.EPARCHY_CODE as eparchyCode from hj_jkcust_tf_f_cust_visit_appointment a left join hj_jkcust_tf_f_cust_visit_record b on a.APPOINTMENT_ID = b.APPOINTMENT_ID where a.PROVINCE_CODE = '36' and a.VISIT_TIME >= #{startTime} and a.VISIT_TIME < #{endTime} and b.APPOINTMENT_ID is null

select ou.org_name as prov, ou.org2_name as city, ou.org3_name as district, CONCAT(LEFT(nc.NATURE_CUST_NAME, 5), '********', RIGHT(nc.NATURE_CUST_NAME, 4)) as natureCustName, nc.NATURE_CUST_ID as natureCustId, CONCAT(LEFT(ou.name, 1), '*', RIGHT(ou.name, 1)) as userName, ou.login as oaAccount, CONCAT(LEFT(ou.phone, 3), '****', RIGHT(ou.phone, 4)) as phone, a.VISIT_TITLE as visitTitle, a.VISIT_TYPE as visitType, a.VISIT_TIME as visitTime, a.IS_INSERT_DIFF as isInsertDiff, CONCAT(LEFT(cvri.INTERVIEW_NAME, 1), '*', RIGHT(cvri.INTERVIEW_NAME, 1)) as intervieweeName, cvri.interview_job as intervieweeJob, cvri.interview_content as interviewContent, a.VISIT_SUMMARY as visitSummary, a.BUSINESS_CODE as businessCode, a.BUSSINESS_NAME as businessName, a.IMPORT_RECOMMEND_PRODUCT as importProduct, a.IS_SUPPORT as isSupport, a.FROM_SOURCE as fromSource from hj_jkcust_tf_f_cust_visit_record a left join prodzqyypt_portal_oa_user ou on a.CREATE_USER = ou.login left join hj_portal_td_m_political_location hpl on a.EPARCHY_CODE = hpl.AREA_CODE left join cust_t_nature_cust nc on a.CUSTOMER_ID = nc.NATURE_CUST_ID left join (select * from hj_jkcust_tf_f_cust_visit_record_intervie group by RECORD_ID) cvri on cvri.record_id = a.RECORD_ID inner join (select max(RECORD_ID) as RECORD_ID from hj_jkcust_tf_f_cust_visit_record vr where vr.customer_id = #{customerId} and vr.CREATE_USER = #{oaAccount}) vr on vr.record_id = a.RECORD_ID

select a.NATURE_CUST_ID as natureCustId, b.NATURE_CUST_NAME as name, b.ONE_LEVEL_NAME as industry, null as level, null as region from cust_t_nature_cust a left join cust_t_nature_cust_trade_info b on a.NATURE_CUST_ID = b.NATURE_CUST_ID where a.NATURE_CUST_ID = #{customerId}
